Candidate C (median) also has a low overall score but shows a large spike in the second window (0.696), indicating that the median is being pulled by a particularly poor model in that window. Given the noisy, unstable nature of the series, the trimmed‑mean approach offers the best balance between robustness and consistency across windows.
